The '''''Pharos''''' was a [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aurin Leith]] served in the ''Pharos''{{'s}} triage bay during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
